definitions.explanation: A creative work (book, film, painting, etc.) that is ordinary and lacks distinction. Not necessarily bad, but not noteworthy either.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{凡作|ぼんさく}だった。
⟦{期待|きたい}していた→期待する：06065_kitaisuru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{凡作|ぼんさく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
examples.english: I had high hopes, but it turned out to be an unremarkable work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天才|てんさい}→天才：09934_tensai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれた→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦{画家|がか}→画家：02583_gaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{凡作|ぼんさく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Even a painter called a genius has some mediocre works.

notes:
USAGE:
{凡作|ぼんさく} is used primarily in criticism and reviews of creative works. It implies something merely average — not terrible, but lacking in originality or impact. The {凡|ぼん} character means "ordinary" or "mediocre."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {凡作|ぼんさく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わる (to end up as a mediocre work)
- {凡作|ぼんさく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}わざる→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}ない→得る：02014_eru⟧ (one must call it mediocre)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{傑作|けっさく}→傑作：00217_kessaku⟧ (masterpiece) and ⟦{駄作|ださく}→駄作：16860_dasaku⟧ (terrible work) are at opposite ends of the quality spectrum. {凡作|ぼんさく} sits in the middle — better than ⟦{駄作|ださく}→駄作：16860_dasaku⟧ but far from ⟦{傑作|けっさく}→傑作：00217_kessaku⟧. ⟦{佳作|かさく}→佳作：22658_kasaku⟧ (commendable work) is slightly above {凡作|ぼんさく}, indicating decent quality.
